items.text:
I docked on a ship, found a breaker container with value: $$$, so I dragged it back to my ship.

Later on, I got CO₂ poisoned for no reason and tried to drive back to K-Leg. Died in the middle of the way. Took me 15 minutes to realize the container was leaking CO₂ into my ship.

What a game, playing it again.
items.text_zh:
我停靠在一艘船上，发现了一个价值为$$$的断路器集装箱，于是我把它拖回了我的船上。

后来，我无缘无故地二氧化碳中毒了，试图开回K-Leg。半路上死了。我花了15分钟才意识到那个集装箱正在向我的船里泄漏二氧化碳。

这游戏真绝，再玩一遍。

items.text:
Where is the Fun ?
I love games like Dwarf Fortress, I enjoyed the EA (because it was EA), but the 1.0 feel worse to play. I discover the fire update and I can only thing: WHY???? Your ship burn ALLLLLL the time! Every actions in the game are tedious, even opening a bag! Crew AI didn't improved, you're just better to play alone, because micro manage your character is already a nightmare, imagine two or more guys... Combat is horrible and don't work with more than one char ? Switching char reset the actions.

This game is just pain. The UI make everything tedious. Ultima 7 in the 90s was 100x better. If AI was smart enough, it could work, but no, you have to micro everything. Huge potential, killed by UI & UX.
items.text_zh:
乐趣在哪里？
我喜欢《矮人要塞》这样的游戏，我享受过EA阶段（因为那是EA），但1.0玩起来感觉更糟。我发现了火焰更新，我只能想：为什么？？？？你的飞船一直一直一直在燃烧！游戏里的每一个操作都很繁琐，连打开一个包都是！船员AI没有改进，你最好还是单人玩，因为微操你自己的角色已经是一场噩梦了，想象一下两个或更多家伙……战斗很糟糕，而且不止一个角色时根本行不通？切换角色会重置动作。

这游戏就是痛苦。UI让一切都变得繁琐。90年代的《创世纪7》要好上100倍。如果AI足够聪明，它或许能行，但没有，你必须微操一切。巨大的潜力，被UI和UX杀死了。

observations.evidence: Your ship burn ALLLLLL the time!
observations.evidence_zh: 你的飞船一直一直一直一直在燃烧！

items.text:
The game looks amazing on streams, and it looks extremely cool on the store page. But it suffers from the same thing a lot of passion projects do--dev myopia. They want this to be a hardcore sim, but not just a hardcore sim a PUNISHING AND TEDIOUS sim.  Toss on top of that a competent but incomplete tutorial that gets you far enough to just be frustrated at everything else that's unexplained and BAM--it's just NOT fun!

The amazing aspects of this game are marginalized so that you can spend the bulk of your time constantly under pressure (no space pun intended), barely making progress b/c it's horrible early on trying to scrape by. And always just waiting on bars to fill up. That is 90% of your time. The other 10% is finding a great part, or facing an exciting challenge that can be overcome.

And all of this is a huge part of why NOBODY, even those who purchase this game, actually play it. As of 8/14/2026 less than 10% of the player base has the achievement for undocking from the station. 90% OF THE PLAYERS HAVEN'T LEFT THE STATION. And of THOSE players that actually have left the station, less than half have the achievement for returning (~4.9% of the playerbase).

I continue to hold out hope for this game. Lowering how hard it is to make your mortgage payment. Ironing out bug fixes. Reducing the rate at which your battery and fuel are depleted (especially for new players) so you're not stranded in space as a new player who's still at the stage where they're wrestling with the UI.... all of these things will go a long way if they ever happen.

In short, just put in a non-sweaty l2p mode for real people (the 90%). I'd even go so far as to add new-player rescue items and hand-holding for how to recover from the most common road blocks--use them as tutorials.

Good luck guys, I hope to one day be switching this review to recommend!
items.text_zh:
这款游戏在直播里看起来棒极了，在商店页面上也显得极其酷炫。但它患上了许多热情项目都会有的毛病——开发者短视。他们想让这成为一款硬核模拟游戏，但不只是硬核模拟，而是一款惩罚性且繁琐的模拟游戏。再加上一个称职但不完整的教程，它让你走得足够远，却只会让你对一切未解释的东西感到沮丧，然后砰——它就是不好玩！

这款游戏那些惊艳的方面被边缘化了，好让你把大部分时间花在不断承受压力上（无意双关太空），勉强取得进展，因为早期挣扎求存实在太糟糕了。而且永远只是在等进度条填满。那就是你90%的时间。另外10%是找到一个好部件，或者面对一个可以克服的激动人心的挑战。

而所有这些都是为什么没有人——即使是买了这款游戏的人——真正去玩它的重要原因。截至2026年8月14日，不到10%的玩家群体拥有从空间站脱离停靠的成就。90%的玩家根本没有离开过空间站。而在那些真正离开过空间站的玩家中，不到一半拥有返回的成就（约占玩家群体的4.9%）。

我继续对这款游戏抱有希望。降低支付房贷的难度。修完bug。降低电池和燃料的消耗速度（尤其是对新玩家），这样你作为还在和UI搏斗阶段的新玩家就不会被困在太空里……所有这些事情如果有一天能实现，都会大有帮助。

简而言之，就是为真正的人（那90%）加入一个不硬核的l2p模式。我甚至愿意进一步加入新玩家救援物品，以及针对如何从最常见的卡关处恢复的手把手指导——把它们当作教程。

祝你们好运，伙计们，我希望有一天能把这条评测改成推荐！

observations.description: 电池和燃料消耗过快，新玩家容易被困太空
observations.evidence: Reducing the rate at which your battery and fuel are depleted (especially for new players) so you're not stranded in space
observations.evidence_zh: 降低你的电池和燃料被消耗的速度（尤其是对新玩家而言），这样你就不会被困在太空中

items.text:
This game is only suitable for a specific group of gamers. 
I think people who liked Neo Scavenger will also like this one. 

It reminds me of good old C64 times.  The manual is useless, and there are barely any ingame hints. There is a readme file in the main folder with some essentials, but actually it is quite fun to figure things out yourself. 
 
Currently the game runs quite stable, although I had one catastrophic failure that destroyed my save game. There are backups available, but make sure to make extra copies as these backups can get corrupted, too. 

Despite the missing content this game is quite some fun already now. 
It was quite annoying to find those leaks. I spend an hour to spot that last leak hidden which pointed out to be a damaged floor hidden under a battery. With the recent update it became much easier to spot those leaks. 
There seems to be limit on how much you can carry, so you can stack crates into each other and basically carry a whole starship around. Easy enough to scrap one hopelessly damaged ship and use the parts to repair a decent one.  

I have not figured out yet how to recruit another crew member. I guess my chosen character traits were too bad for that strange "socializing" combat game.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏只适合特定的一群玩家。
我觉得喜欢《Neo Scavenger》的人也会喜欢这款游戏。

它让我想起了美好的C64时代。手册毫无用处，游戏内的提示也几乎没有。主文件夹里有一个readme文件，里面有一些要点，但实际上自己摸索出东西来还挺有趣的。

目前游戏运行相当稳定，尽管我遇到过一次灾难性故障，毁掉了我的存档。有备份可用，但一定要额外多复制几份，因为这些备份也可能损坏。

尽管内容有所缺失，这款游戏现在就已经相当有趣了。
找出那些泄漏点相当烦人。我花了一个小时才找到最后那个隐藏的泄漏点，结果发现是藏在电池下面的一块损坏地板。随着最近的更新，找出这些泄漏点变得容易多了。
携带量似乎有上限，所以你可以把箱子套进彼此里面，基本上能带着一整艘星际飞船到处跑。把一艘彻底损坏的飞船拆解掉，用零件修好一艘还不错的飞船，这足够简单。

我还没搞明白怎么招募另一名船员。我猜我选择的角色特质对那个奇怪的“社交”战斗游戏来说太差了。
